blockers.symptom: CMake configure fails: 'Failed to extract nvcc implicit link line'. cmake/cuda.cmake forces CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER to CUDAToolkit_NVCC_EXECUTABLE, which on CoreX is a bash shim that produces no objects.
blockers.error_snippet: CMake Error at .../CMakeNVCCParseImplicitInfo.cmake:141 (message): Failed to extract nvcc implicit link line.

attempts.action: Reproduced the wall with an unmodified baseline configure (corex_port/build/baseline_configure.log).
Patched cmake/cuda.cmake to detect ${CUDAToolkit_BIN_DIR}/clang++ and use it as CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER on CoreX (ID=ILUVATAR), falling back to nvcc on real NVIDIA.

blockers.final_verdict: Configure succeeds; CUDA compiler detected as CoreX Clang 22.1.0.

blockers.symptom: nvgpu_softmax.cu:202 host code: 'no matching function for call to max'. CoreX clang++ only sees __device__ overloads of max().
blockers.error_snippet: error: no matching function for call to 'max'

attempts.action: Added #include <algorithm> and changed max(...) to std::max(...).

blockers.final_verdict: All 13 CUDA .cu op kernels compile with CoreX clang.

blockers.symptom: Target property CUDA_ARCHITECTURES set to NVIDIA sm numbers (50;52;61;70;75) is not valid for the CoreX clang backend, whose only arch is ivcore11.
blockers.error_snippet: N/A (proactively corrected per nvcc-flag-translation before it could break codegen)

attempts.action: Guarded the arch block on CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER_ID==ILUVATAR and set CUDA_ARCHITECTURES ivcore11 (+ CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=ivcore11 env).

blockers.symptom: A full `cmake --build build` also builds ~48 OpenCV image-demo examples and 3 pipeline examples; some fail to link (undefined reference to cv::putText/cv::imwrite) and the pipeline headers miss <string>/<cstdio> under clang. These targets are NOT part of the CUDA backend.
blockers.error_snippet: undefined reference to `cv::imwrite(...)`; error: implicit instantiation of undefined template 'std::basic_string<char>'; use of undeclared identifier 'stderr'

attempts.action: Confirmed OpenCV 4.6.0 (CoreX build) is installed and cv::putText/cv::imwrite symbols exist in libopencv_imgproc/imgcodecs; the failure is OpenCV example link wiring (OpenCV_LIBS) + clang header hygiene, independent of the CUDA port.
Scoped the migration build to the CUDA backend targets (tengine-lite, tengine-lite-static, tm_classification_cuda) which build cleanly; the CPU reference tm_classification also builds.

blockers.final_verdict: Not a CUDA-backend blocker. The CUDA library + CUDA example build and run on GPU; OpenCV/pipeline demo examples are orthogonal and left out of the CUDA migration surface.
